'''Sludge Kintan''' was a [[Kintan crusher]] who roamed the grounds of [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Sludge Kintan wandered outside the edges of the palace foraging. However, before the end of the Cold War, the crusher was attacked by someone allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
